# 21 Draw

> > 21 Draw provides video courses and how-to-draw books taught by world-renowned artists to help aspiring artists master digital art, character design, and drawing fundamentals.

21 Draw is a Sweden-based online art education platform offering comprehensive courses in Procreate, digital drawing, 3D art, and character design. The platform features instruction from renowned artists like Loish, Jazza, and Leonardo Pereznieto, with content available in 10+ languages.

## Key Topics

- Procreate
- Digital Art
- Character Design
- Drawing Courses
- Video Courses
- Blender
- 3D Art
- Online Learning
- Art Education
- Beginner-Friendly
- Animation
- iPad
- Photoshop
- Drawing Tutorials
- Online Courses

- [21 Draw Homepage](https://www.21-draw.com): 21 Draw homepage offering video courses and books with Procreate and Photoshop

## Courses & Learning

- [Course Catalog](https://www.21-draw.com/course): Browse 21 Draw's course catalog with Adobe, Procreate, and Clip Studio Paint
- [Beginner Courses](https://www.21-draw.com/course-level-beginner): Beginner art courses in digital drawing, 3D, manga, and character design
- [21 Days to Master Digital Drawing](https://www.21-draw.com/course/21-days-digital-art): 21-day Procreate digital drawing fundamentals course by Erika Wiseman
- [Learn 3D Art in 21 Days](https://www.21-draw.com/course/3d-art): 21-day beginner-friendly 3D art course by Mychael Hennig
